notes: more and more is the progression participle holekh's own rendering under rule 56's auxiliary-verb clause, and the and inside it coordinates the parts of that one rendering rather than two source items (rule 14's closing sentence), so the coordinating waw between the two participles is unrepresented, exactly as rule 56 directs for a connective the ASV leaves unwritten between such a pair.

The single supplied relative That is given to the first of the two coordinated attributives under rule 41; the competing reading attaches it to shineth, before whose word the ASV wrote it, and is named in the unit note under rule 8.
The participles follow the noun they modify, so rule 41's attributive reading governs and the relative is not added under rule 55.

or nogah is rendered with the rectum attributive and the construct as the English head, so the single supplied determiner is the construct noun's (rule 29); in the following chain a written article stands on the rectum and takes the the before a supplied one does (rules 29, 47).
